content.title: Which players have won a golf career Grand Slam? - ESPN
content.text: Richard Heathcote/Getty ImagesESPNJul 20, 2025, 01:47 PM ETReactionsIn men's golf, it's all about the majors: the Masters, the PGA Championship, the U.S. Open and the Open Championship. While the Masters might be the most prestigious tournament, any major win is considered a notable achievement for a professional golfer.Rory McIlroy became the sixth men's golfer to complete a career Grand Slam after winning the 2025 Masters. After winning the 2025 Open Championship, Scottie Scheffler now only needs a U.S. Open win to complete the feat. Jordan Spieth and Phil Mickelson also need one major each to complete a career Grand Slam -- the PGA Championship and U.S. Open, respectively.On the women's side, seven LPGA golfers have completed career Grand Slams by winning four different majors. Only Karrie Webb has achieved a super career Grand Slam, winning five majors after a fifth was added in 2013.
